recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not add a broader required-score invariant without a new CQI decision covering current data-exchange, subject-list, pending/error, and other report scenarios.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive CQI request to improve Measure/MeasureReport validation by supporting measure score units, ensuring score/type expectations, adding a stratifier value/component invariant, and making Quality Reporting conformance guidance accessible.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-26681. The relevant source appears through nearby Measure/MeasureReport work: mrp-1 and mrp-2 were present from the 2021 MeasureReport source rework, scoringUnit was added as a first-class Measure element in J#28936 history, and Jira's 2025 comments confirm scoringUnit and mrp-2 satisfy the tracker notes.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active build resources. Later Measure approach work moved calculation metadata to group-level elements, so scoringUnit is now Measure.group.scoringUnit. FHIR-20509 renamed the old data-collection report type to data-exchange, and this run fixed stale wording for that related issue before auditing the seed. Later report-type behavior means a new unconditional required-score invariant would be broader than the applied seed decision.
reconciliation: No additional FHIR-26681 source change was made. Current source has Measure.group.scoringUnit, mrp-1 for data-exchange no-group/no-score behavior, mrp-2 for stratum value xor component, invariant examples, and links from Measure/MeasureReport pages to Quality Reporting guidance.

related_jiras.note: Renamed the report type exception from data-collection to data-exchange; fixed separately in this run.
Related Measure history added scoringUnit and group-level calculation elements as first-class source elements.
Current Measure approach places calculation metadata such as scoringUnit at the group level.
